notes: v580 — GRADING WITHOUT THE UPLOAD (works fully once the w419 server update is pasted). Until now, every first grade of the day slimmed and uploaded hundreds of thousands of price bars to the server — data the server's own store already holds — which is where the 90-second ‘Grading every signal…’ waits came from. Now the app simply asks the server to grade its OWN store at your 💧 floor: nothing uploads, and the day's answer is cached server-side so the second device (your phone) gets it instantly. Until w419 is pasted the app quietly falls back to the old upload path, so nothing breaks in the meantime. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
